verdict.rationale: MX documents a Platform API with a published OpenAPI specification covering its core connectivity products, including aggregation, verification, identity, balances and statements, and pairs it with the Connect Widget. However, nothing shows that UI-only functions are exposed through the API: webhook creation, editing and testing, API key rotation, user lookup, SSO setup and mobile maintenance mode are all documented only as Client Dashboard tasks. Missing for 10: any explicit API-to-UI parity statement, API coverage of Client Dashboard management functions (webhooks, API keys, user lookup, SSO, mobile maintenance mode), and independent corroboration of parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: This repository contains the OpenAPI specification for the MX Platform API
Use the Connect Widget and Platform API to let end users connect to their accounts.
You can download our OpenAPI Specification and import it into Postman to learn more about our API and its request and response payloads.
